records.text: Archived State Farm Stadium calendars showed no RV show scheduled for the weekend of Charlie Kirk's memorial.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I went back on Wayback Machine, ... saved screenshots. ... There was no RV show that was on the calendar for this Cardinal Stadium.

verification.notes: Independent AP reporting corroborates the substantive conclusion that the stadium was available on September 21, 2025, and searches found no RV-show listing for that weekend. However, the specific archived-calendar screenshots cited by Owens were not publicly retrievable, so the archival-inspection claim itself could not be directly authenticated.

records.text: Candace Owens said the Wayback Machine showed only one listing from Erika Kirk's corporate real-estate career.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And when we dig up the relic of what that, what she was doing in corporate real estate, all we can find on Wayback Machine is that she had one listing.

verification.notes: A public StreetEasy record identifies one Corcoran listing under Erika Frantzve, while Zillow currently reports zero sales/listings. This supports the existence of one discoverable listing, but the exhaustive claim that the Wayback Machine showed only one could not be reproduced from current search access.

records.text: The earliest Wayback Machine evidence that Proclaim Streetwear offered clothing for sale is January 16, 2021.

verification.notes: A live search did not surface a stable Internet Archive capture index proving January 16, 2021 was the first snapshot with clothing for sale. Wayback coverage is incomplete and the earliest available capture would not necessarily prove first commercial availability.
